function.name: get_available_slots
function.description: Returns the rep's next available video-call slots. Call this tool only at the booking phase of the call — specifically, after the close-transition pitch has been delivered AND the prospect has explicitly stated a scheduling time preference (e.g. "morning", "Tuesday afternoon", "later this week", "tomorrow"). Required inputs: days_ahead (integer, typically 7).

days_ahead.description: Number of days from today to look ahead for available slots
